body:
_Migrated from issue #1290, filed 2026-08-01._

Two related gaps found while unwedging the wiki sync during an autopilot tick.

## 1. A README-only doc PR can silently freeze the public wiki

`scripts/generate-wiki.py` has a drift tripwire (Pass 3): any H1–H3 in a source doc that no `{{repo:...}}` directive consumes, and that isn't in `IGNORED_SLUGS`, fails the run. That's a good check — but **nothing runs it in CI**. There's no workflow and no test that invokes the generator, so the tripwire only fires inside the autopilot tick, after the offending commit is already on `main`.

What that cost: two README-only PRs added sections without a matching wiki directive —

- `37aa39c00` (#1174, Sponsors) added `## Supporting the project`
- `d6be3e70a` (#1152) added `### Reverse proxy with a prefix`

The first tick after them tripped the tripwire (`2026-07-28T02:05:14Z`; last clean run `2026-07-28T00:05:48Z`), and it failed **every tick for four days**. The live wiki's last commit was `e2b550c77` dated 2026-07-24, so the public wiki sat frozen while `main` moved. Fixed now (directives added to `wiki-src/Configuration.md` and `wiki-src/Contributing.md`; wiki republished, 6 files / +82 −5), but the class recurs on the next docs PR.

A unit test that runs the generator against `wiki-src/` and asserts rc=0 would have caught both at review time — cheap, and a natural Layer 2 gate per the verification standard.

## 2. There are two wiki pipelines and only one is wired up

`0f879dbb1` (#527/#843/#765, 2026-07-13) copied the whole system **into** the repo: `repo/scripts/generate-wiki.py`, `repo/scripts/sync-wiki.sh`, `repo/wiki-src/`. Nothing invokes that copy — `scripts/autopilot-tick.sh:437` runs the outer `scripts/sync-wiki.sh`, which hardcodes the outer `generate-wiki.py` + `wiki-src`.

The two have diverged. The repo copy is newer in one respect (it has a `{{repo:...#__document__}}` feature the outer one lacks) and carries **7 platform pages that have never been published**: `Install-on-QNAP`, `Install-on-Synology`, `Install-on-TrueNAS-SCALE`, `Install-on-Unraid`, `Install-with-Docker-Compose`, `Install-with-Dockge`, `Install-with-Portainer`. The live wiki has 15 pages, none of them these.

So someone wrote seven install guides that no user can read. That needs a deliberate call: either promote the repo copy to canonical (point `sync-wiki.sh` at `repo/wiki-src`, publish the install pages) or delete it as dead weight. Fixing only the outer copy — which is what today's unwedge did — widens the split.

Worth noting the repo copy trips the same tripwire, so switching to it is not a drop-in.
title: Wiki sync has no CI gate, and repo/wiki-src is a divergent unpublished copy
